methods.start(result, source, kernel): Refresh F=-source*kernel and independent Fcc=-kernel*source on COMPLETE 0..order block; call actual upstream vie2_start
methods.step(n, result, source, kernel): Caller imports current physical kernels first, then this refreshes slice n and calls upstream vie2_timestep; n>order
methods.refresh(n, source, kernel): Refresh current fixed-kernel convolution slice; all required histories are caller-owned

cpp.objects: A40 p254::Green alias = cntr::herm_matrix<double>; nt=N-1; ntau=max(2*order+2,12); same dimension/statistics throughout; p254::clear every fresh object; import R(n,m) and lesser(m,n) for m<=n. Caller keeps Matsubara/mixed storage initialized exactly zero.
cpp.build: CMakeLists.txt links installed pinned libcntr.so and Eigen; reuses unmodified A40 header; no replacement VIE integrator

python.call: solve_supplied(times, source_ret, source_less, kernel_ret, kernel_less, statistics=-1 or +1, order=1..5, binary=path, workdir=fresh_outside_git_path, beta=positive_finite) -> solution.npz path
python.read: load_solution(path) -> dict times, statistics, order, beta, ret, less, f_ret, f_less, fcc_ret, fcc_less
python.shape: All components [N,N,d,d] complex128. R(t,s) is causal zero above time diagonal. Lesser is full, with lesser(t,s)=-lesser(s,t)^dagger. No arbitrary independently supplied non-Hermitian legs can be represented by this source/solution object.
python.persistence: Original full input arrays retained in input.npz before packing. Exact-argv command/stdout/stderr/exit and raw transport byte bindings retained in workdir. solution.npz is actual decoded saved-output boundary, consumed by consume_solution.py.
python.numerical_reader: consume_solution.py SOLUTION.npz REPORT.json computes final full density (-i G<) or position covariance (+i D<), initial/final traces and causal-upper-R defect from saved numeric arrays.

transport.header: little endian <8siiiid: magic, nt, dimension, order, statistics, inert_beta
transport.times: N consecutive float64 times, starts zero; one uniform positive dt; explicit [0,1,10,30] unsupported, never interpolated
transport.block_layout: n=0..nt, m=0..n, row-major d*d complex128. R stored as R(n,m); lesser stored as lesser(m,n). Header and times precede blocks. No extra bytes accepted.

invariants: statistics -1 fermion G0/Sigma; +1 physical real Cartesian POSITION D0/Pi; no thermal helper
Source R diagonal copied exactly, including raw fermion unitary drift or zero position diagonal; no canonical replacement
Full initial rho/covariance is supplied lesser data; no refill, clipping, mass/frequency scaling or state repair
Zero mixed/imaginary correlations with finite inert beta; zero mixed makes a wrong statistics sign numerically inert, not verified sensitive
Gaussian finite oracle producers are separate from general supplied-kernel consumer
No q/-q packing equivalence asserted; all independent original material legs remain external/raw and must be evaluated before any admitted physical Cartesian packing
scope_limits: Linear VIE for caller-supplied kernels is not by itself selfconsistent feedback or physical closure
No NiH/material accuracy or ab-initio PBE/correlation-residual double-count prescription claimed
A40 original proofs carried, not rerun; A28-A48 source files not edited
